models_evaluated: 125 model configurations from 33 base models across 14 providers

links.outcome: Risk exploration and supportive conversation in multi-turn high-risk mental health vignettes
links.effect: Leading models had combined-risk scores above 95, while risk exploration varied substantially among lower-performing configurations.
links.quote: Leading models combined strong supportive conversation with combined-risk scores above 95, whereas risk exploration exposed substantial variation among lower-performing configurations.

unlisted_practices: Therapeutic system prompting gave configuration-specific gains concentrated among weaker models
Elevated reasoning settings produced no average improvement
Frozen LLM judge calibrated against clinician consensus (94.2% exact agreement)
Protected test materials in a public leaderboard to prevent direct optimisation
Synthetic patient conversations compared with real human-AI conversations

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM safety and conversational risk in mental health conversations across 125 model configurations and tests the effect of therapeutic prompting as a guardrail/deployment practice.
